title: DigitalThreadPackingArmEvent
description: Shared event contract for the Digital Thread lab. The simulator, the real-arm agent, Glue/Athena/Redshift, and the fault-alert Lambda all depend on this schema. Treat it as design data: it captures requirements for a 5-axis pick-and-place packing cell, including the robot program and firmware versions that produced each event. Change it deliberately, version it, and keep producers and consumers in sync.

timestamp.description: UTC instant the event was observed on the device, ISO-8601 with Z.

robot_id.description: Stable identifier of the packing arm, e.g. arm-01.

cell_id.description: Lab cell the arm belongs to, e.g. lab-cell-01.

item_id.description: Item currently in work, if any.

order_id.description: Customer or lab order the box is being packed for.

fault_code.description: Set on FAULT (and sometimes GRIP_FAIL) events.

fault_axis.description: Joint index 1–5 when the fault is axis-specific (AXIS_LIMIT, JOINT_OVERCURRENT, sometimes COLLISION).

cycle_time_ms.description: Set on PLACE_OK: elapsed ms from ITEM_PRESENTED to place.

program_version.description: Version of the packing program / robot configuration that produced the event. This is a digital-thread field: it links design and requirements to observed faults.

firmware_version.description: Motion-controller / firmware version running on the arm.

tcp_x_mm.description: Tool-center-point X in the cell frame, millimetres.
